claims.claim: The Light API is served at https://sandbox.meshulam.co.il and https://secure.meshulam.co.il under /api/light/server/1.0/, accepts multipart/form-data, and reports every outcome in the body with HTTP 200 (status 1 success, status 0 failure).

The Light API router answers an unrecognised endpoint name with err as the plain STRING "unknown method", which is the negative control that makes endpoint existence testable without credentials. Endpoints verified to EXIST on both sandbox.meshulam.co.il and secure.meshulam.co.il: /api/light/server/1.0/createPaymentProcess /api/light/server/1.0/approveTransaction /api/light/server/1.0/getTransactionInfo /api/light/server/1.0/getPaymentProcessInfo /api/light/server/1.0/createPaymentLink /api/light/server/1.0/getPaymentLinkInfo /api/light/server/1.0/createTransactionWithToken /api/light/server/1.0/getTokenTransactionsByExternalIdentifiers /api/light/server/1.0/refundTransaction /api/light/server/1.0/cancelBitTransaction /api/light/server/1.0/settleSuspendedTransaction /api/light/server/1.0/createFarPaymentRequest /api/light/server/1.0/updateDirectDebit . Verified NOT to exist on either host: /api/light/server/1.0/getTokenOnly /api/light/server/1.0/updatePaymentLink /api/light/server/1.0/updateRecurringPayment . All are invoked as POST, i.e. POST /api/light/server/1.0/createPaymentProcess POST /api/light/server/1.0/approveTransaction POST /api/light/server/1.0/getTransactionInfo POST /api/light/server/1.0/getPaymentProcessInfo POST /api/light/server/1.0/createPaymentLink POST /api/light/server/1.0/getPaymentLinkInfo POST /api/light/server/1.0/createTransactionWithToken POST /api/light/server/1.0/getTokenTransactionsByExternalIdentifiers POST /api/light/server/1.0/refundTransaction POST /api/light/server/1.0/cancelBitTransaction POST /api/light/server/1.0/settleSuspendedTransaction POST /api/light/server/1.0/createFarPaymentRequest POST /api/light/server/1.0/updateDirectDebit . The non-existent ones are also referenced in the skill as POST /api/light/server/1.0/getTokenOnly .

createPaymentProcess is served at /api/light/server/1.0/createPaymentProcess with a multipart/form-data request body. transactionTypes entries are declared type integer with documented method values: [0] Credit Card example 1, [1] bit example 6, [2] Apple Pay example 13, [3] Google Pay example 14, [4] bank transfer example 15, [5] Pay Box default 5. The array index selects the slot AND the value is a numeric method code; the v1.2.1 claim that no numeric value-codes exist was wrong.

approveTransaction requires pageCode, transactionId AND transactionToken. Probed live: sending pageCode plus only transactionId returns err.id 54 naming transactionToken as the missing field, and sending only transactionToken returns 54 naming transactionId.

Grow webhooks are authenticated via a webhookKey field carried in the payload (there is no X-Grow-Signature header). Common webhook fields: webhookKey, transactionCode, paymentSum, paymentDate, fullName, payerPhone, payerEmail, cardSuffix, cardBrand, asmachta, paymentSource. Recurring adds directDebitId, paymentsNum, periodicalPaymentSum. Failed recurring adds error_message, charges_attempts, regular_payment_id. Invoice webhook adds invoiceNumber, invoiceUrl.

createTransactionWithToken parameters (Grow Light API): the saved-card-token parameter is `cardToken` (NOT `token`); `paymentType` value 2 = Regular; a recurring series is linked by `recurringDebitId` (the value returned by the first premium-recurring payment; there is no `isRecurringDebitId` flag); the endpoint uses `userId` (not `pageCode`) and its required fields are cardToken, userId, sum, description, paymentType, pageField[fullName], pageField[phone], recurringDebitId, transactionUniqueIdentifier.

claims.claim: Grow's own error table gives the cause of HTTP 403 as a missing X-API-KEY header, not a client-side request.

The Light API endpoints /api/light/server/1.0/updateDirectDebit and /api/light/server/1.0/createFarPaymentRequest exist on both sandbox.meshulam.co.il and secure.meshulam.co.il: each returns a validation error object, whereas an unrecognised endpoint name returns the string "unknown method". Conversely getTokenOnly, updatePaymentLink and updateRecurringPayment return "unknown method" on both hosts and therefore do not exist. Referenced in the skill as `POST /api/light/server/1.0/updateDirectDebit` and `/api/light/server/1.0/createFarPaymentRequest`.
Error codes exist beyond the published table: settleSuspendedTransaction with an unmatched userId returns err.id 743 (אין עסק תואם ל userId שנשלח).
Grow documents a 3D Secure service on a dedicated reference page at https://developers.grow.business/reference/3ds-1 .
